Admin.invVoidHelp: For an invoice raised by mistake. The store is not charged, and its status doesn't change.

Admin.payDescription: Today's payment attempts across every store. Read-only: a payment counts only when the provider confirms it.
Admin.payNeedsLookLink: This payment is waiting in Failed checks
Admin.payReadOnlyNote: Nothing can be changed here. Payments are confirmed by the provider's own status check.
Admin.chkDescription: Payment checks the system couldn't settle by itself and a person has to look at.
Admin.chkRule: A payment can't be marked paid by hand. It counts only when Bakong or PayWay reports the exact amount in the right currency — so here you can ask again, or close the case with a note.
Admin.chkExplain_provider_unreachable: The provider's status service kept failing, so we don't know yet whether the buyer paid. The order is still waiting. Ask again: if the payment is there, the order is confirmed.
Admin.chkExplain_amount_mismatch: The provider reports a payment, but not for the order's exact total. The order was not confirmed. The seller and buyer need to settle the difference or refund.
Admin.chkExplain_currency_mismatch: The provider reports a payment in the other currency. We never convert a payment to make it fit, so the order was not confirmed. The seller needs to refund it or agree with the buyer.
Admin.chkExplain_paid_after_expiry: The exact amount arrived, but after the code expired and the order was cancelled. The money is with the seller; they need to refund it or send the order anyway.
Admin.chkRecheckHelp: Asks the provider for this payment's status once more.
Admin.chkNoChange: Same answer as before. Nothing changed.
Admin.chkConfirmed: The provider now reports the exact payment. The order is marked paid and the seller has been told.
Admin.chkCloseHelp: When it has been dealt with outside the system. Say what was done. The order itself doesn't change.

Admin.bakConfirmTitle: Back up the whole database now?

Admin.bakStaleDo: Press Backup now, then check that the worker is running.
Admin.bakStaleTell: Tell an owner or support so they can back up now.
Admin.bakNoDownload: There is no download button, on purpose: a backup holds every buyer's phone and address, so it stays in the private storage.
Admin.bakKeptDays: {count, plural, =0 {Deleted tonight} one {# more day} other {# more days}}
Admin.bakEmpty: No backups yet. The first one runs tonight at 03:00.
Admin.bakFullBody: Restoring the whole platform replaces the live database, so it is never a button here. It is done by hand, step by step:
Admin.bakFullStep1: Restore the backup into a new, empty database.
Admin.bakFullStep2: Compare the counts it prints with the live site.
Admin.bakFullStep3: Switch the app over to the new database.
Admin.bakFullLink: Open the steps (go-live.md, "When something goes wrong")
Admin.bakTestLate: It is late — test a restore once a month.
Admin.bakShopBody: For when a seller deleted or broke their products or settings by mistake.
Admin.bakNever: Never restored: orders, payments, buyers, stock movements, subscription and invoices. They are records of what really happened.
Admin.bakShopSearch: Search by shop name or link
Admin.bakPart_products: Products, their options, prices, descriptions and photos
Admin.bakChange_changed: Goes back to how it was
Admin.bakPhotosNote: Photos come back if their files still exist. Photo files are kept at least {days} days.
Admin.bakSafety: Just before the restore, the shop's current catalog is backed up, so this restore can be undone the same way.
Admin.bakTypeSlug: Type the shop's link to confirm: {slug}
Admin.bakDoneBody: {store} is back to the backup from {when}. The seller was told on Telegram, and the audit log has the counts.
Admin.bakAlreadyRunning: A backup is already waiting or running.
Admin.bakWaitingLong: Still waiting after 2 minutes: the worker may be stopped, or backups aren't switched on (BACKUPS=on).
Admin.bakTestRecord: I tested a full restore today
Admin.bakTestConfirmBody: Only after you restored a backup into a new database and its counts matched the live site. It goes in the audit log.
